ruthless-coder-ai-keyword-icons-root.description: Generate clean monochrome PNG icons from a keyword — three distinct concepts per keyword, 1:1 aspect ratio, transparent background, recolorable, ready to drop into PowerPoint, Keynote, or docs. Use this whenever the user asks for an icon, pictogram, or "a simple graphic that represents X" (hospital, growth, contract, security, teamwork…), in any language, even if they never say the word "icon". Also use it when the user wants to recolor, resize, or tweak an icon made earlier.
